# Report 1 -- Rubric

The full marking rubric for Report 1 is provided as a separate PDF. Download it from the [BEDA handbook](https://biol2022.github.io/BEDA-handbook/module02/206-rubric.html) or from the BIOL2022 Canvas site. Read the rubric and use it as a check-list before, during and after writing your report, and again before you submit it.
